name: UOW students: free 12-month GoGet membership
summary: University of Wollongong students can get a free 12-month GoGet car share membership and special hire rates.
key: UOW students can access a free 12 month membership and special hourly or daily hire rates through the GoGet website.
how: Sign up through GoGet's UOW student page.
GoGet posts you a smart membership card. Students in on-campus residences can collect it from their residence.
